rule_semantics.run_length: sum over variable_runs entries of (at + element_length), plus the tail of the last entry for that slot
rule_semantics.at: constant filler bytes from the current cursor to the start of this element; the cursor starts at the beginning of the run and advances past each element
rule_semantics.tail: constant bytes from the end of this element to the end of the run; only the last entry for a slot carries a non-zero tail
rule_semantics.string: ff fe ff <u8 units> then units UTF-16LE code units, so 4 + 2*units; ff fe ff ff <u16 units> then 6 + 2*units
rule_semantics.count: count_width bytes of count at the cursor, then stride bytes per element, so count_width + stride*count
rule_semantics.conditional: predicate_width bytes read at predicate_at relative to the cursor; the element is width bytes when the value is in values and 0 bytes otherwise; predicate_at bytes are part of at
rule_semantics.opaque: length is not computable from the bytes at hand; a segmenter must refuse rather than guess

Measured lead is 114 for the first moDefaultRefPlnData_c of every one of the 9 traced parts, whose normal is +Z (Front, the identity basis), and 186 for the second and third, whose normals are +Y and +X. moCompFeature_c.note: The only slot holds this class single child, a classref to moUnitComponent_c that the traces record as external#43 in eight parts and external#45 in vendor_cojinete. re/data/external_classes.json slot component measures that class at own_body_lengths [0] with one nested object reference of traced_span_lengths [2], so the whole child subtree is 4 bytes: 2 for the classref tag, 0 of own body and 2 for the object reference. The traced scope from the end of this class own tag is 93 bytes in the 18000-era authored parts and 89 bytes in the 13000/14000-era vendor parts, so run 0 is 93 - 4 = 89 at document version 18000 and 89 - 4 = 85 at 14000 and 13000. Consecutive instances are 119 bytes apart in the authored parts and 115 in the vendor parts, so the array length is 93 + 119*(n-1) or 89 + 115*(n-1) by generation. moCompFeature_c::Serialize itself contributes at most two i32 flags, both gated on moArchiveHelper_c::hasCondition bits set by the caller rather than by the stream, and then FUN_4bbb16e0, which for ver >= 0x4a5 reads only the i32 tree node id and a su_CTime, 8 bytes, matching the id at end-8 and the time_t at end-4. The length is gated on the document version rather than on a positional predicate because a predicate inside this run would have to be read at an offset that depends on the run length being computed.
